name: Salome
source:
A regal and faultless woman, who is both a devoted wife and mother. She is well-educated, well-read, and loves to be in the company of similar people.

Uses she/her pronouns.
Likes: People with strong spirits and spicy food.
Dislikes: Bawdy and thoughtless jokes.
